personality_one_liner: A high-precision, tactical esports operations console designed for gaming cafe managers and floor staff to monitor dual-branch rigs, manage live station telemetry, stream POS snacks, and control high-speed walk-in sessions.

spacing.rule: High-density command center rhythm with clear grouping, comfortable tap zones (>=44pt), and sticky bottom actions over scrolling lists.

dos: Use subtle glass with >=75% dark tint on sticky bottom CTA bars and filter chips
Use backdrop blur on station telemetry drawer modals and quick-bill drawers
Keep text on top of glass high-contrast with onSurface tokens
donts: Never put blur over raw station metric numbers or rapid timers
Do not use heavy multi-colored glass cards in data-dense table views

screens.name: Floor / Live Stations
screens.purpose: Primary operational floor console showing live station cards (FREE / PLAYING / BOOKED / MAINTENANCE) with real-time countdown timers, current rate, rig hardware badges, and instant quick-actions.

states.loading: Centered esports telemetry spinner with animated neon scanline skeleton placeholders for station tiles
states.empty: Station icon illustration + 'No gaming stations found for selected shop or filter' + 'Add Station' CTA
states.error: Telemetry sync error banner with detailed error code and 'Retry Live Sync' CTA

screens.layout: Sticky Shop Switcher Header (Shop 1: Cyber Arena Indiranagar vs Shop 2: Neon Zone Koramangala) + Filter Chip Row (All, PS5, PC Master, Free, Playing, Booked) + 2-Column Responsive Tactical Grid of Station Cards + Floating Walk-in Session Action Bar at bottom with safe area padding.

screens.name: Owner Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level dual-branch business intelligence view featuring today's revenue, active hours, rig utilization % comparison, snack sales, and live floor occupancy comparison.

states.loading: Metric card skeletons with pulsating gradient bars
states.empty: Bar chart icon + 'No session data recorded for this date range' + 'Switch Date Range' button
states.error: Financial sync error message with 'Reload Financials' CTA

screens.layout: Dual-Branch Comparison Toggle + KPI Metric Tiles (Today Total Revenue ₹, Active Hours, Occupancy %, Peak Load) + Side-by-side Revenue Breakdown Chart (Gaming Time vs F&B Snacks) + Recent High-Roller Sessions Feed + Low Inventory Alert Strip.

screens.name: Walk-in & Quick Session Modal
screens.purpose: High-speed counter workflow to assign a customer to an available PC or PS5 station, select hourly package or open-ended post-pay mode, add gamer tag / phone, and launch timer in under 5 seconds.

states.empty: No stations available illustration + 'All stations currently occupied. Add to waitlist queue.' CTA
states.error: Validation alert banner with 'Fix Form & Retry' CTA

screens.layout: Header with selected Station badge + Customer Quick Search / New Gamer input (Phone / Tag) + Duration Selector Pills (1h ₹120, 2h ₹220, 3h ₹300, All-Night Pass ₹699, Open Timer) + Snack upsell addon drawer + Large bottom sticky 'Launch Session (₹)' primary button.

screens.name: Station Detail & Live Telemetry
screens.purpose: Focused control panel for a single station to monitor live elapsed/remaining countdown, current bill breakdown (gaming + snacks), add extra time, add snacks, switch station, or end session & generate GST bill.

states.empty: Station offline icon + 'Station is currently decommissioned' + 'Mark Active' CTA
states.error: Connection drop warning banner with manual override options

screens.layout: Station Header with Hardware Spec (e.g., RTX 4080 240Hz / PS5 Disc + DualSense) + Live Giant HUD Countdown Timer + Active Gamer profile pill + Running Bill Accordion (Time Cost ₹ + Attached Food & Drinks ₹) + Quick Action Matrix (Extend 30m, Add Snacks, Pause, End & Settle Bill).

screens.name: POS & Snacks Bar
screens.purpose: Fast-tap food & beverage catalog for energy drinks, snacks, cold water, and ramen with instant station attach or takeaway checkout.

states.empty: F&B cup illustration + 'No items found in this snack category' + 'Clear Filter' CTA
states.error: POS catalog load error with 'Refresh Catalog' CTA

screens.layout: Category Navigation Pills (All, Energy Drinks, Chips & Snacks, Cold Beverages, Hot Ramen/Meals) + 2-Column Product Grid with high-contrast price tags in ₹ and stock count badges + Sticky Floating Cart Drawer bar showing total item count and 'Attach to Station / Checkout ₹' CTA.

screens.name: Bookings & Slot Reservations
screens.purpose: Timeline and list of advance customer bookings for PC tournament squads and PS5 couch-coop gaming sessions across both shops.

states.empty: Calendar icon + 'No advance bookings scheduled for today' + 'Create Reservation' CTA

screens.layout: Shop Selector + Date Horizontal Scroller + Status Filter (Upcoming, Confirmed, Checked-in, Cancelled) + Booking Card List with customer phone, advance deposit ₹, requested game, and 'Check-in to Station' button.

screens.name: Inventory & Stock Tracking
screens.purpose: Real-time stock management for cold drinks, chips, peripherals (controllers, headsets), and low-stock replenishment reorders for both shops.

states.empty: Box package illustration + 'Inventory catalog is empty' + 'Add Item' CTA

screens.layout: Search Bar + Low Stock Quick Warning Banner + Tabbed Category List (Drinks, Food, Hardware/Peripherals) + Stock item rows with in-stock stepper adjustments and cost per unit.

screens.name: Customers & Gamer Profiles
screens.purpose: Directory of gamers, visit frequency, lifetime spend, wallet credit balances, VIP rank badges, and WhatsApp invoice dispatch status.

states.empty: User profile illustration + 'No customer records match search' + 'Register Gamer' CTA

screens.layout: Search by Mobile/GamerTag + VIP / Member tier filter + Customer List Cards (Name, Phone, Total Hours, Wallet Balance ₹, Preferred Rig) + Tap to Top-up Wallet / View Session History.

screens.name: Reports & Analytics
screens.purpose: Comprehensive audit & operational reports with daily cash/UPI settlement, game popularity rankings (e.g. Valorant, FC 25, GTA V, Tekken 8), and staff shift logs.

states.empty: Analytics report icon + 'No settlement records found for selected period' CTA

screens.layout: Date Range Picker + Branch Filter + Summary Cards (Total Cash, Total UPI/Card, Discount/Voucher deductions, Net Profit) + Top Games Played Table + Export PDF/WhatsApp Summary action bar.

screens.name: Authentication & Branch Switcher
screens.purpose: Secure pin/password login supporting Role-Based Access (Owner, Manager, Staff Counter, Customer Kiosk) and instant active shop branch assignment.

states.error: Invalid PIN / Branch unassigned warning alert

screens.layout: Branded NexusArena Cyber Logo + Role Badge Switcher (Owner Admin vs Counter Staff) + Numeric Keypad / PIN input + Active Branch selector card (Indiranagar Cyber vs Koramangala Neon) + 'Access Floor Console' primary action button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility palette with electric neon emerald (#00FF9D) as the primary active brand hue, deep obsidian (#090D14) for root canvas, and graphite (#111827) for cards.
Banned colors: No purple, no indigo, no generic blue corporate default. Keep all surfaces dark obsidian and carbon with high contrast text.

Status Indicator Protocol: FREE stations must display Emerald (#10B981) pill, PLAYING stations must display Bright Ember Red (#EF4444) pill with live dynamic countdown/elapsed timer, BOOKED stations must display Amber (#F59E0B) pill, and MAINTENANCE stations must display Muted Slate (#475569) pill.
Currency formatting: Always format money values with Indian Rupee symbol (₹) and comma separation (e.g., ₹120, ₹1,450).
Font weights: Strictly cap font weight at 500 maximum across all headers, cards, and data badges. Use font size scale (sm:12 to 2xl:24) for hierarchy rather than fake heavy bolding.

Dual Shop Branch Support: Every core view (Floor, Owner Dashboard, Inventory, Bookings, Reports) must have an instant branch toggle (e.g. 'Shop 1: Indiranagar' vs 'Shop 2: Koramangala') or 'All Shops' aggregate mode for Owner role.
Touch Targets & Haptics: All station cards, POS cart add/remove buttons, and session action triggers must meet minimum 44x44pt touch targets with subtle haptic feedback on action commit.

Sticky Bottom CTA: Walk-in session builder, POS checkout cart, and Station Session End bill drawers must have anchored bottom containers above safe area with top subtle border divider so content scrolls smoothly beneath without obstruction.
Zero Emoji Policy: No emoji anywhere in system UI. Use Ionicons vector icons with single consistent outline/fill styling.
